summary: Admin Dashboard post-restore is FULLY OPERATIONAL. All 23 sidebar entries accessible (78 permissions confirmed by full menu visibility), all routes return 200, KPIs cross-check with DB (45 items match perfectly, 1 today matches 1 displayed). NF525 Audit Trail shows fresh login hash f35d1c97 chained from previous — chain integrity preserved through restore. Login/logout flow functional. Visual: zero raw labels, coherent layout, brand intact, Audit Trail NF525 widget is a standout owner-night reassurance feature. 2 cosmetic P2 findings (Total commandes counter drift Vue d'ensemble vs Suivi en direct; PENDING_CREATE_3e69b24b3b84 leak in profile dropdown). Filiale selector legitimately absent (V1 single-restaurant). No P0/P1 blockers.
